headline: Meta reconsiders 2030 net-zero goal amid AI data center emissions
summary: Meta is reconsidering its 2030 net-zero sustainability goal following record emissions from AI data centers, according to its 2026 sustainability report. Ars Technica describes the goal as being re-evaluated, while TechCrunch reports Meta has already walked it back, and both outlets note the decision could affect other tech companies' climate commitments.
